scope: REQ-linked differential slices for accepted http-core-v1 hardening and protocol boundaries; not full OSS nginx behavioral parity
outOfScope: Complete nginx OSS request/response differential suite

slices.notes: Canonical URI vs raw request_uri comparison matrix recorded in the REQ
Nginx accepts deep pipelines; SDKWork http1MaxPipelineDepth is intentional hardening
Pinned probe records nginx idle frames without proactive PING
Early upstream response + request lifecycle differential
keepalive_time vs SDKWork proactive connectionMaximumAge retirement

Single-page full-surface behavioral regression (REQ-2026-0040): routing, URI semantics, static, proxying, LB, filters, limits, TLS SNI, http2 ALPN, stream; the probe owns mock upstreams, staging render, and server lifecycle (see the REQ for the alignment findings it closed). `cases` is the executed-case floor: tools/run-nginx-behavioral-corpus.mjs fails the gate when the probe reports fewer cases than declared, so deleting a case cannot silently shrink coverage.

Conditional requests, byte ranges and cache policy compared field by field against a real nginx binary (REQ-2026-0071). Uniquely, this slice owns its oracle: tests/nginx/differential/nginx-oracle.json is the real-nginx side, so the comparison still runs where nginx is absent. `cases` is the executed-case floor enforced by tools/run-nginx-differential.mjs.

Broad HTTP surface compared field by field against a real nginx 1.29.6 binary (static delivery/MIME/HEAD/ranges incl multipart/conditionals, routing and rewrite, response headers, error_page mapping, gzip negotiation, allow/deny + auth_basic, limit_req/limit_conn, proxy_pass URI splice/Host-forwarded/hop-by-hop/upstream status mapping). Wave 3a/3a-2 added the nginx autoindex family (html/json/jsonp/xml listings), empty_gif and the loopback-gated stub_status page, plus Wave 3a's charset family and gzip refinements. Wave 3a added the nginx charset family (charset/charset_types/source_charset/override_charset header filter) and the gzip refinements (gzip_disable msie6/regex user-agent gating, gzip_proxied Via policy). The slice owns its oracle: tests/nginx/differential-http/nginx-oracle.json is the real-nginx side, so the comparison still runs where nginx is absent; intentional differences are justified per-field in compare.py. `cases` is the executed-case floor enforced by tools/run-nginx-differential-http.mjs, and the oracle is pinned to nginx/1.29.6 by the same gate.

PRD-nginx-compatibility §5/§6 virtual-host selection and bounded named-location internal redirects compared against a real nginx 1.29.6 binary: exact / leading wildcard (any depth, longest) / trailing wildcard (longest) / dot-prefix / regex (authored order, nginx case folding) precedence, default-server fallback, and try_files/error_page → @named targets (return, root, proxy_pass). The slice owns its oracle: tests/nginx/differential-host/nginx-oracle.json is the real-nginx side, so the comparison still runs where nginx is absent; intentional differences (nginx's built-in 404 page body) are justified in compare.py. `cases` is the executed-case floor enforced by tools/run-nginx-differential-host.mjs.
